results.title: Squeal
results.overview: A pig masked killer targets and slaughters drug users.

results.title: Jared Leto: Hollywood's Dark Secret
results.overview: An investigative documentary exploring long-standing and newly detailed allegations of sexual misconduct, grooming, and criminal sexual conduct against Oscar-winning actor and Thirty Seconds to Mars frontman Jared Leto.

results.title: Fırtına Kız
results.overview: Zeynep inherits the extraordinary talent of her father İsmail, once known as Diyarbakır’s most gifted yet unluckiest footballer. But talent alone is not enough, she must fight for equal opportunity to pursue her dreams. As İsmail struggles to accept his daughter’s ambition, Zeynep is forced into marriage, only to make a daring escape. Haunted by the sacrifice of a sibling who took the blame for her, she pushes forward and ultimately steps onto the field wearing the national team jersey, becoming a symbol of hope and courage for countless girls.

results.title: Senior Moments
results.overview: These three characters’ stories mirror the real-life struggles faced by many senior citizens, reminding us that, despite differences in background or circumstances, the challenges of aging are universal. Through these emotional narratives, Senior Moments aims to foster empathy and a deeper understanding of the elderly, whose needs and experiences are often overlooked in today’s fast-paced world.

results.title: Elephants in the Fog
results.overview: In a small Nepalese village nestled in the heart of a forest populated by wild elephants, Pirati is the matriarch of a Kinnar community. She dreams of escaping to a “normal” life with the man she is in love with. But when one of her daughters disappears, she must investigate and choose between love and responsibility to her community.

results.title: The Otherkind
results.overview: Chaos seeps into a sleepy mountain lake town, as something sinister comes to the surface.

results.title: The Irregular at Magic High School THE MOVIE - Yotsuba Succession Arc -
results.original_title: 魔法科高校の劣等生 四葉継承編
results.overview: The invitation has arrived. It's time for the New Year's Reception at the Yotsuba family residence. This year, Miyuki and other candidates will gather there to decide who will be the next leader of their powerful clan. If chosen as successor, she would never again have to see her brother live as an outcast. At the same time, such a position would surely entail a political marriage, leaving her mind in complete turmoil. To complicate matters, the current head of the family sows doubt with a shocking statement. When the new year arrives, their relationship may change forever...

results.title: The Little Mammoth
results.overview: Fluffy the baby mammoth awakens after a thousand-year slumber in the icy desert and sets out to find his mother. They say she can be found in distant and mysterious Africa. But Africa is far away, and getting there is extremely difficult, and the baby mammoth's only companion is a chick named Tupik, who dreams of performing his rap at the "Africa's Got Talent" competition. Together, they must overcome numerous challenges: crossing the ocean on an ice floe, escaping from bloodthirsty crocodiles, defeating treacherous hyenas, performing their music in front of a wide variety of audiences, and, most importantly, learning to be friends and understanding that friendship means responsibility and support.

results.title: High Tension
results.overview: In a dark night, a man takes help of a cyclist to get petrol for his motorbike.

results.title: POV: Pasilip On VMX
results.overview: Seductresses Lea Bernabe and Rhian Rivera invite you to spy on their wild, secret encounters. From hot hidden moments to shameless private acts, this is the ultimate VMX voyeur compilation for your viewing pleasure.

results.title: Mr. X
results.overview: Centers on secret intelligence agency cases involving five major national threats that were thwarted through covert operations.

results.title: Skyscraper Live
results.overview: No ropes. No fear. Free solo legend Alex Honnold risks it all in a high-stakes, live ascent of one of the world's tallest skyscrapers in Taipei, Taiwan.

results.title: Ottam Thullal
results.overview: Priest Appu warns Rajan not to cut a sacred Pala tree in Methanam village. Rajan ignores him and dies three days later. Appu predicts five more family deaths in 16 days. Rajan's doubtful son calls it fake, sparking comedic escape attempts.

results.title: Casa Pequena
results.overview: Five musicians travel to a secluded house in the Serra da Estrela mountains, hoping that a retreat will renew their friendship and creativity, but a mysterious host will place the band at the center of an intrigue. Is this house cursed?

results.title: The Beachnickers 3
results.overview: Rocha decides to foot the bill for his daughter's wedding in an island and invites his loyal colleagues, Alexandre, Lima, and Diguinho, along with their families, to the all-expenses-paid celebration. The setting seemed perfect for an unforgettable trip, but the peace is short-lived, soon giving way to a series of surprises and mishaps.

results.title: Maxo: Forbidden Ritual
results.overview: Crushed by extreme poverty and haunted by the fear of losing another child after a miscarriage, the lives of Phú and his pregnant wife Thảo spiral further into darkness when Phú’s mother, Mrs. Thuận, dies because the family cannot afford her medical treatment. In desperation, Thảo follows the advice of Mrs. Tánh—a neighbor who performs spiritual rituals—and summons a wandering spirit to become a household ghost, believing it will protect their home and unborn child. But when the entity hidden within the corner of the house begins to demand its debt, Thảo realizes in horror that the thing she invited in to save her family is, in fact, a nightmare with no escape.

results.title: Daffy Season
results.overview: Daffy is ready for Duck Season, but Elmer is too immersed in his new obsession – soccer – to come hunting. Slowly the world around Daffy turns into a zombie-esque nightmare as the Tunes become obsessed with the sport.

results.title: The Ogre's Bride
results.overview: In a Japan where humans and demons co-exist peacefully, Yuzu is an ordinary high school girl who lives in the shadow of her older sister, who is the bride of a demon. One day, she has a life-changing encounter with a beautiful ogre who claims her as his bride.

results.title: The Hunter
results.overview: In the rural interior of Paraná, an elderly worker, ravaged by hunger, follows the trail of a mysterious black dog that hunts to survive.
